AMENDED 2026-07-24: the TC-4 cases previously carried placeholder TC-3 rungs — an empty-bounds authority chain that proved trivially, no acceptance, no elections — and still read verified:true. They now supply the inherited rungs for real, and two net-new cases pin the inheritance directly (drop the acceptance, drop the forum → TC-4 no longer verifies). Composition steps are still appended ONLY when a composition slot is supplied, so the base walk is unchanged in shape. SUPERSEDED PIN (2026-08-07): dispute-resolution examples generalized -- no provider names in illustrative examples; atrHash 0xa5215e6a2f6af04c310e1298ead8b5733ce7221e0691836edb1aabb7437cd225 -> 0x03c975b03f5742b2eb7e5c7cf22a3af16082a04241c975e3e47c2d5b8b012413, re-derived independently with python3 hashlib over the exact atrBytes_utf8. AMENDED 2026-08-19: supportedClass is now computed from the steps (the highest class whose every required step is proved) instead of echoing the claim, so the three cases whose named gap blocks a rung report the class their proved rungs reach — TC-3, TC-2, TC-2 — where all three previously read TC-4. `verified` is unchanged: it still answers whether the walk affirms the CLAIMED class. SUPERSEDED PINS (2026-09-02): the ATR's format-version member was renamed twice before any release carried it — `lcp` (which collided with the LCP specification's own version line) became `atr`, and `atr` (which names the artifact rather than its version) became `atrVersion`, because a version field names what it versions.
